[[Olympique de Marseille]] won '''Division 1 season 1989–90''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 53 points.

* [[AS Nancy]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A
* [[Stade Rennais]]: Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group B
